name: Change history
description: Who changed what and when, from the Intune audit log. Includes deletions and renames.
note: Intune's audit API can only filter on date and activity type. A policy or account filter is applied after collection, so the run time is set by how many events happened in the window, not by how many match. A large tenant can produce well over 100,000 events in a week, and reading them takes minutes. Narrow the dates or set an activity type to make it faster.

fields.label: From date
fields.hint: Graph holds two years of audit events. Leave blank for seven days ago.

fields.label: Activity type (optional)
fields.hint: Filtered by Intune itself, so this is the one option that genuinely makes the query smaller. Enter a wrong value and the valid list is returned.

fields.label: Policy name or ID (optional)
fields.placeholder: leave blank to see everything that changed
fields.hint: An ID is exact and survives renames. A name is matched as recorded at the time, so a renamed policy may have history under both.

fields.label: Changed by (optional)
fields.patternMessage: Enter a full user principal name, such as someone@contoso.com
fields.hint: Filled alongside a policy above, both must match.

fields.label: Look up each actor's current Intune role
fields.hint: Roles are read as they are now, not as they were at the time of the change. Needs DeviceManagementRBAC.Read.All.

shortDescription: who changed what and when, including deletions
